plans.idea: Classic wide split: the sneaker is the large hero on the left, and the right column has the brand-to-action order: Voltstride logo on top, then the headline, subline and DROP 07 stack, then the Enter the Draw pill, all sharing one left edge.

Mirrored, copy-first banner: logo, headline block and CTA form a left-aligned column you read first, and the sneaker sits large on the right, so the eye moves left to right from brand to message to product.

Three-column banner: the sneaker on the left, a tall centre column where the headline can set large on two lines, and a narrow right column where the logo sits at the top and the CTA pill at the bottom, framing the message.
